title: E-bike sales in Valdoria by region, 2024 and 2025
bodyMd: The bar chart shows the number of new e-bikes sold in each of the four regions of the fictional country of Valdoria in 2024 and in 2025, in thousands of units. The four regions together make up the whole country.

data.caption: New e-bikes sold in each region of Valdoria, 2024 and 2025, thousand units.

accessibilityText: A grouped bar chart with a supporting table. For each of four regions there are two bars, 2024 and 2025, showing new e-bikes sold in thousands. Alta: 40 thousand in 2024, 50 thousand in 2025. Bassa: 25 thousand, then 35 thousand. Costa: 60 thousand, then 66 thousand. Monti: 15 thousand, then 24 thousand. National totals are 140 thousand in 2024 and 175 thousand in 2025.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional country, written for this item set. Figures were chosen so that percentage changes and shares resolve by hand. Not derived from any real dataset or published test item.
